sample.question_description: Find the first blocked move in a command sequence.
sample.question_preview: Using the Skybridge 3D movement rules, which command is the first one that fails? Sequence: right, left, right, right, right, down. Options: [1] move 3 [2] no...
sample.question:
Using the Skybridge 3D movement rules, which command is the first one that fails? Sequence: right, left, right, right, right, down.
Options:
[1] move 3
[2] no move is blocked
[3] move 1
[4] move 5
[5] move 6
[6] move 4
[7] move 2
sample.analysis:
Move 1 right: blocked (outside the board).
Move 2 left: moved (normal height rule).
Move 3 right: moved (normal height rule).
Move 4 right: blocked (outside the board).
Move 5 right: blocked (outside the board).
Move 6 down: moved (normal height rule).
The first failing command is move 1. Therefore choose option 3.

state_content.rules: Move between adjacent towers. Climb up at most 1 level normally; ladder edges allow climbing up 2 levels. Descending is always allowed.
